title: Dramatic Glacial Ice Wall from Water, c. 1950s Landscape Snapshot Photo
description: A sweeping black and white landscape snapshot capturing a massive, deeply fissured glacial wall meeting calm waters. Tall seracs and jagged ice pinnacles stretch across the horizontal frame beneath a soft, overcast sky, highlighting the rugged textures and colossal scale of a northern fjord or polar environment. The reverse side features a brief cursive inscription reading 'David sent picture' alongside a faint printed mark 'A7'.
